name: io.github.harshavardhankotu/sitefix-launch-gate
title: SiteFix Launch Gate — Pre-Deployment Website QA
description: Strictly isolated public MCP server for deterministic website launch QA (HTML metadata, Open Graph, Schema.org JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap.xml). Zero PII, zero auth required.

tools.name: sitefix_check_url
tools.description: Run a deterministic, SSRF-protected pre-deployment website QA audit on a public URL.

tools.name: sitefix_get_findings
tools.description: Fetch deterministic findings and distinct per-check IDs for an existing completed SiteFix audit ID.

tools.name: sitefix_generate_fix_preview
tools.description: Generate a non-PII defect summary and ₹499 Fix-Pack + verification recheck preview for a public URL.
